acs.text_first_line: AC1 The WIN file exchange reaches one host through one egress path
AC2 The file landing and staging area is private, sized and swept
AC3 The dispatch and ingest worker pools scale on their queue depth
AC4 Every credential comes from the key store and is rotated without a rebuild
AC5 The dispatch files of a business date are stored and addressable
AC6 A late WIN batch is visible on the freshness signal

ops_provided: the one-hop egress path and client certificate for the WIN SFTP exchange
the private staging area and the delivered-file store of the business date
the dispatch and ingest worker pools with their KEDA scalers
the key-store entries for the certificate, the host key, the storage reference and the client material
the six observability signals and the freshness alert for a late WIN batch
